Kit Pricing

Refund Policy

Effective November 24, 2026

All sales are final

Kit subscriptions and one-time credit packs are non-refundable except where applicable law requires a refund. We do not provide refunds for unused credits or partial subscription periods.

Cancel future renewals

Sign in to your Kit account, select Manage subscription, and cancel before your next billing date. Check the confirmation for when your paid access ends.

Billing errors and statutory rights

If you see a duplicate or unauthorized charge, or want to exercise a statutory refund or withdrawal right, email rex@kitgameengine.win. Include your account email and receipt or invoice reference. This policy preserves your rights under applicable law.
